name: Limey Captcha Alert Theme
description: Styles captcha-alert messages as dark red auth-screen alert boxes in Discord and doubles as a sign-in device for the Limey dashboard (Login with Extension). Author detection is resilient to Discord DOM changes (id attributes, avatar URLs, tag pills). Only the Limey bot and WEBHOOK-tagged authors that post captcha alerts are flagged (never humans or other bots); can be locked to a single webhook. Targeting config and styles auto-update from the owner's server. Pure client-side CSS — nothing is read from or sent to Discord.
